subject: INITIALIZE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-02 (PB152). Section selection keys on ROOT MEMBERSHIP in DataBinder.LocalStorageRoots, never on 'not a file record': 13.18.63.4 GR2/GR3 leave file-section and linkage initial values undefined or governed by 13.7, so those sections are outside this rule's reach entirely and a negative test would sweep them in. pb152_options_initialize_sections probes BOTH directions - a clause naming LOCAL-STORAGE alone must leave WORKING-STORAGE at its baseline - because a one-section probe passes for the wrong reason under an implementation that ignores the section list and fills everything. LOCAL-STORAGE is automatic data (13.6.4 GR1), so the background is re-laid on EVERY activation; pinned by a two-CALL golden that mutates the item in between.
